verdicts.reason: A keeps the headline and a readable yellow 'Pick Your Flavour' CTA, but breaks up the flavour list: 'Cola Crash' sits alone under the logo, 'Lime Zap' and 'Grape Pop' are tiny and jammed around the CTA, and the five items are out of order. B has a cleaner headline row, but its CTA is a tiny, illegible white pill under the logo. B also turns the remaining flavours into an unreadable micro-list on the right and shrinks the can to a sliver, so the call to action effectively disappears.
